en.title: Sensor data is late
en.msg: Data from the BMS did not arrive on time, so the proposal cannot be assessed.
en.action: Check the edge–BMS link. The zone stays on BMS control.

id.title: Data sensor terlambat
id.msg: Data dari BMS tidak diterima tepat waktu, sehingga usulan tidak bisa dinilai.
id.action: Periksa koneksi edge–BMS; sistem tetap di kontrol BMS.

en.title: Sensor quarantined
en.msg: A critical sensor is quarantined because of drift or failure.
en.action: Recalibrate or replace the sensor, then record it.

id.title: Sensor dikarantina
id.msg: Salah satu sensor kritis sedang dikarantina karena drift atau rusak.
id.action: Kalibrasi atau ganti sensor, lalu catat di sensor_calibrations.

en.title: Invalid sensor value
en.msg: A sensor value is outside the physically possible range.

id.title: Nilai sensor tidak valid
id.msg: Nilai sensor di luar rentang fisik yang mungkin.

en.title: Sensor data looks suspect
en.msg: A critical sensor is flagged as suspect, for example early drift.
en.action: QA decides whether calibration is needed.

id.title: Data sensor diragukan
id.msg: Ada sensor kritis berstatus curiga (mis. awal drift).
id.action: QA meninjau dan memutuskan perlu kalibrasi atau tidak.

en.title: Already outside limits
en.msg: RH or ΔP is already outside the zone limits.
en.action: Handle the deviation per SOP. No saving is applied.

id.title: Kondisi sudah di luar batas
id.msg: RH atau ΔP saat ini sudah melewati batas zona.
id.action: Tangani deviasi sesuai SOP; tidak ada penghematan yang dijalankan.

en.title: Forecast crosses a limit
en.msg: The worst case in the next 30 minutes crosses a zone limit.
en.action: Keep BMS control and watch the zone.

id.title: Prediksi menembus batas
id.msg: Skenario terburuk 30 menit ke depan menembus batas zona.

en.title: Safety margin is thin
en.msg: Distance to the zone limit is under 1 unit after uncertainty.
en.action: QA or Engineering reviews before continuing.

id.title: Margin keselamatan tipis
id.msg: Jarak ke batas zona kurang dari 1 unit setelah ketidakpastian.

en.title: Interlock active
en.msg: A door or equipment interlock alarm is active in this zone.

id.title: Interlock aktif
id.msg: Ada alarm interlock pintu/peralatan di zona ini.

en.title: Zone under maintenance
en.msg: Zone equipment is inside a maintenance window.

id.title: Zona dalam perawatan
id.msg: Peralatan zona sedang dalam jendela perawatan.

en.title: Outside qualified range
en.msg: The proposed fan speed is below the qualified range.
en.action: Limit the optimizer to the zone envelope.

id.title: Di luar rentang terkualifikasi
id.msg: Setpoint yang diusulkan di bawah rentang fan yang sudah dikualifikasi.
id.action: Optimizer harus dibatasi ke envelope zona.

en.title: Change is too large
en.msg: The setpoint change exceeds the step limit per proposal.

id.title: Perubahan terlalu besar
id.msg: Perubahan setpoint melebihi batas langkah per usulan.

en.title: Critical batch step
en.msg: The zone is running a critical batch step, such as spray coating.
en.action: Wait until the critical step ends.

id.title: Tahap batch kritis
id.msg: Zona sedang menjalankan tahap batch kritis (mis. spray coating).
id.action: Tunda perubahan sampai tahap kritis selesai.

en.title: All checks passed
en.msg: The proposal is safe to send for approval under the current mode.
en.action: Approve in Advisory mode, or log only in Shadow mode.

id.title: Semua pemeriksaan lolos
id.msg: Usulan aman untuk diteruskan ke persetujuan sesuai mode operasi.
id.action: Lanjut ke persetujuan (mode Advisory) atau catat saja (mode Shadow).

scenarios.title: Periode Shadow
scenarios.description: AI memprediksi & mengusulkan; tidak ada perintah ke BMS.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: Semua recommendations.status = SHADOW_LOGGED; tidak ada approval/command.
scenarios.test_focus: Mode Shadow tidak pernah membuat actuation_commands
scenarios.behavior_en: All recommendations are logged only; no approvals or commands.

scenarios.title: Optimizer 0.9 mengusulkan perubahan saat spray coating
scenarios.description: Optimizer versi 0.9.0 belum tahu jendela tahap kritis.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: Gate TINJAU RULE_CRITICAL_BATCH_STEP; versi 1.0.0 menahan usulan (hold).
scenarios.title_en: Optimizer 0.9 proposes changes during spray coating
scenarios.behavior_en: Gate Review (critical batch step); version 1.0.0 holds proposals instead.

scenarios.title: Pintu A3 tidak menutup rapat saat hujan deras
scenarios.description: RH 55,6–55,9 %RH dan ΔP 8,6–9,1 Pa selama ±30 menit (mode Shadow, BMS statis).
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: Gate TAHAN (PRED_LIMIT_BREACH lalu CBF_LIMIT_BREACHED); deviasi DEV-2026-031 + CAPA ditutup 30 Sep.
scenarios.title_en: A3 door not fully closed during heavy rain
scenarios.behavior_en: Gate Hold (forecast breach, then limit breached); deviation DEV-2026-031 and CAPA closed 30 Sep.

scenarios.title: Periode Advisory
scenarios.description: Usulan LULUS perlu persetujuan Engineering; TINJAU perlu QA.
scenarios.behavior_en: Approval → command → feedback; energy down about 33% (simulated).

scenarios.title: Reset jadwal BMS saat produksi mulai
scenarios.description: Saat okupansi naik, BMS kembali ke setpoint statis (perubahan konservatif otomatis).
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: audit_events action BMS_SCHEDULE_RESET; usulan baru perlu persetujuan lagi.
scenarios.title_en: BMS schedule reset at production start
scenarios.behavior_en: BMS returns to static setpoints; new proposals need approval again.

scenarios.title: Perintah ke BMS timeout
scenarios.description: Satu perintah FAILED (BMS_TIMEOUT), dicoba ulang 2 menit kemudian.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: actuation_commands status FAILED + baris retry (retry_of); feedback NOT_APPLIED.
scenarios.behavior_en: One command FAILED (BMS_TIMEOUT) and retried 2 minutes later.

scenarios.title: Koneksi edge–BMS putus
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: Fallback site ke BMS statis; DQ freshness & missing; tidak ada inferensi di 2 interval; celah TIDAK diimputasi.
scenarios.behavior_en: Site falls back to static BMS; data gap kept empty; no inference for 2 intervals.

scenarios.title: Drift sensor RHT-B3
scenarios.description: Nilai terukur naik 0,05 %RH/jam; RH sebenarnya normal.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: SUSPECT 29 Sep 09:45 (gate TINJAU DQ_SUSPECT_INPUT) → QUARANTINED 13:30 (gate TAHAN) → fallback zona → kalibrasi 1 Okt → VALID.
scenarios.behavior_en: Suspect → quarantined → zone fallback → recalibration → valid again.

scenarios.title: Rollback manual oleh QA
scenarios.description: Operator melaporkan keseimbangan exhaust FBD; QA mengembalikan A1 ke BMS.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: actuation_commands status ROLLED_BACK; approval A1 berikutnya ditolak sampai 22:00.
scenarios.behavior_en: Command ROLLED_BACK; further A1 approvals rejected until 22:00.

scenarios.title: Perawatan AHU-09
scenarios.behavior_en: Gate Hold (maintenance lock); zone on BMS control.

scenarios.title: Interlock pintu airlock gagal
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: Gate TAHAN INTERLOCK_ACTIVE/CBF; deviasi DEV-2026-034 OPEN dengan draf CAPA dari AI.
scenarios.behavior_en: Gate Hold (interlock); deviation DEV-2026-034 open with an AI-drafted CAPA.

scenarios.title: Nilai ΔP tidak valid
scenarios.behavior_en: Reading marked INVALID; range event logged.

scenarios.title: Jam edge bergeser 40 detik
scenarios.description: source_timestamp lebih awal 40 detik dari ts.

scenarios.title: Lonjakan partikel acak
scenarios.behavior_en: Readings marked SUSPECT; spike events logged.

scenarios.title: Tenant B untuk uji isolasi data
scenarios.description: Tenant kedua dengan 2 zona dan 1 hari data.
scenarios.expected_system_behavior: User tenant A tidak boleh melihat baris tenant B (RLS).
scenarios.behavior_en: Tenant A users cannot see tenant B rows (RLS).

conn_en.Edge ke cloud (MQTT TLS, satu arah): Edge to cloud (MQTT TLS, one way)

Rainy weather, keep the BMS setpoint.
